name: ravensight
description: Set up Ravensight, connect your agent, instrument games and websites, and use studio evidence. Playtesting is separate.

defaultPrompt: Help me set up Ravensight for this game.
Use my Ravensight studio evidence to plan the next improvement.
interface.longDescription: Guides developers through Ravensight game and website setup, SDK instrumentation and studio workflows. Includes five agent skills and the public documentation MCP. Company and Game Website tracking use separate anonymous website keys. Account-specific analytics and setup require a separate authorized, scoped studio connection; no account credentials are bundled. Playtesting is optional and installed separately. The skills explain consent, event parity, heatmaps and usage limits without automatically granting access or starting paid work.
